saw_lines: Mushroom buyers pick a product for one daily effect, like sleep or focus, then reorder the same jar for months.
So the sale is won or lost in the first line, where a buyer decides if it is worth a click.
Your site shows 661 reviews on its best seller, yet 0 of 30 ads carry a proof number. Put that count on the creative and open two ads with review quotes.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 17 Oct 2026
points: Your site shows review counts from 224 to 661, yet 0 of 30 ads carry a proof number, so new buyers get no trust signal. Put the 661 count on the creative and open two ads with a review quote.
Your site offers 10% off the first order, yet 0 of 30 ads mention it, so a first time buyer has no reason to act today. Put that offer in the opening line of three new ads and on the creative.

Your site has a shipping policy page, yet 0 of 30 ads mention shipping or delivery, so a buyer wondering about arrival has nothing to act on. Open new buyer ads with one line on how and when the order arrives.
Creator posts run as brand ads
4 of your 30 ads are creator posts run from the brand page, so a personal review reads like an ad. Whitelist those 4 from the creator account and cut three new variations that keep the creator voice.
